summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature across monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs; set_rnd skips __ attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset takes patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; math replaced by numpy ceil), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_missing_len). Nothing was run, per instructions, so the pinned random values in test_loading_array are unverified until pytest runs. Nothing is committed.
